doc: The wipe edge sweeps from right to left (same direction convention as slideLeft: the name describes the direction the edge travels). The edge is at x = (1 - p)·W; the outgoing clip keeps the area left of the edge, the incoming clip keeps the area right of it, and neither side moves. Channel values are a fraction of the canvas width: clipInsetLeft/Right = 0 means no crop, = 1 means fully cropped.
